title: Renewable Energy Planning Database (REPD), quarterly extract Q2 2026
publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
refresh: Quarterly; take the latest each November. The file name and media URL change every quarter — copy the new CSV link from the page.
attribution: Contains public sector information from the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
caveats: Projects of 150 kW and above only: rooftop and small solar is not in REPD.
Coordinates are British National Grid for the whole UK, including Northern Ireland.

stats.label: Offshore wind capacity (MW)
stats.question: offshore wind power capacity
caveats: Each wind farm sits at the coordinates REPD gives for it, out at sea; it is named after the nearest local authority.
Some North Sea farms (Hornsea, East Anglia) lie east of the map edge at 1.9°E: they count towards the answer but are not drawn.

absentFrom.Northern Ireland: Northern Ireland has no operating offshore wind farm.

stats.question: hydro-electric schemes
caveats: Counted as schemes, not megawatts: by capacity a handful of large Highland schemes decide the line on their own. Pumped storage is excluded.
